# TIN Finder — FATCA/CRS

> Free lookup tool for Tax Identification Numbers (TIN) by country — for individuals and entities, for FATCA and CRS reporting.

TIN Finder helps users find the local name, format, examples, and official sources for tax identification numbers across 230+ countries and territories. Content is available in Hebrew, English, Spanish, French, Russian, and Chinese, and results can be exported as TXT or PDF.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search a country and view its TIN name, format, examples, and where to find it.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about TIN, FATCA, CRS, and how to use the tool.
